parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with printed maps. It has a diameter of approximately 25 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information such as continents, countries, and oceans. It can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around a tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of plastic, consisting of a stand and an arm that holds the sphere in place.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the rotating sphere, maintaining the globe’s upright position.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing the sphere to rotate freely around its axis.
